notes.title: Polter Pals is in the PAX x EGX Indie Showcase!
notes.content:
Polter Pals was one of 20 games selected to be in the PAX x EGX Indie Showcase! There's an updated demo live on the store page for you to enjoy, and I'll be taking part in the digital convention fun all week. Throughout the week, I'll be streaming here and on Twitch, so stop by and say hello or ask some questions!

notes.title: Polter Pals Quick Pitch
notes.content:
Make ghost friends by steering the living into deadly hazards to release their souls. Puzzle through diorama-style levels and make as many friends as possible using comically fatal accidents. Keep up with the latest memes by getting popular on the afterlife's hottest social media app, LiveBurial. Get a unique look at the dysfunctional, hyper-consumerist world of the living through the posts of your social media-obsessed Polter Pals.
